requirements.requirement: The system must render a test case validating that an overall score value is displayed when a valid explainability payload is provided.
The system must render a test case validating that a list of measures is displayed when present in the payload.
The system must render a test case validating that each measure displays its corresponding weight or contribution value.
The system must render a test case validating that contribution breakdown elements (e.g., percentages or bars) are correctly calculated and displayed.
The system must render a test case validating that the UI structure (score header, measures, contributions) matches the expected component hierarchy in MessageBubble.
The system must render a test case validating that an empty measures array results in a graceful UI state without runtime errors.
The system must render a test case validating that partial weights (missing or null values) do not break rendering and are handled with fallback display logic.
The system must render a test case validating that malformed payload structures do not crash the component and instead trigger safe fallback rendering.
The system must render a test case validating that missing overall score values result in omission or fallback display without UI failure.
The system must render a test case validating that duplicate or inconsistent measure entries are still rendered deterministically without duplication errors.
The system must render a test case validating that the component integrates correctly with mapped API responses from EVAL-EXPLAIN-UX-S4.
The system must render a test case validating that rendering performance does not degrade beyond acceptable thresholds for typical payload sizes.
